contexts.text: Some spirits fell on me... striking a tremor in my nerves and bones... SE 2550.
They trembled a man to his brother () = general terror. Explained.
They trembled () = terror.
Under Alarm, see this reference.
They who are in good do indeed tremble at the presence of the Divine; but it is the holy tremor which precedes reception...
The whole mountain trembled-tremiscebat exceedingly () = the commotion of Heaven.
A tremor such as there is when Divine truths are being received. Signified.
A holy fear which is sometimes conjoined with a holy tremor of the interiors of the mind... supervenes, when life from the Lord enters...
Evil Spirits possessed the joints of my whole body with a tremor...
Sirens moved my hair and scalp tremulously.
Some of those who supposed they could do all things... began to tremble grossly... At the presence of a little one they staggered and trembled.
The influx of the (Spirits who actuate the Quakers) formerly threw them manifestly into a tremor... (It is not so great now. LJPost 59.)
A certain celebrated Roman... then began to be moved with a kind of holy tremor...
For a trembling seized all the bodies (of the Moravian Spirits), which terrified them.
Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me () = the distress (felt in temptation).
The Church is said to shake and tremble () when it is perverted by the falsification of truths. AE 400:8.
The Church devastated is signified by the whole land trembled ().
When, in place of love to the Lord, there reigns the love of self... the mountains are said to tremble contremiscere (). AE 405:45.
That all the Knowledges... are then disturbed is signified by the islands shall tremble... ().
They then experience such tremor... that they flee... AE 414, Signified.
The earth trembled () = the state of the Church then wholly changed.
The vehement power of Divine truth and the consequent terror is described by the heavens and the earth shall tremble ().
The fishes... the bird... the wild beast... and every creeping thing... and every man... shall tremble before Me () = that all things of man, as to the things of the Church with him, will be changed.
That the holy tremor which seizes upon, agitates, and convulses the interiors of the head, when the Divine inflows, is called fear, etc. Illustrated.
